div.div: Starts runners, restarts one that crashed or stalled with back-off and crash-loop protection, updates them between jobs with roll-back, cleans their disks, and shows it all in a window and a tray. The window is a Tauri app in the user's session; the service is a separate Rust process that owns the runners; a pure Rust core holds every rule.

text.tspan: Starts runners, restarts one that crashed or
protection, updates them between jobs with
roll-back, cleans their disks, and shows it all
in a window and a tray. The window is a Tauri
app in the user's session; the service is a
separate Rust process that owns the runners;
a pure Rust core holds every rule.
